rules.sentence: Unique CSF biomarkers are being studied and appear promising in helping to diagnose neurosyphilis in otherwise borderline or equivocal cases, where available.
These include beta-2 microglobulin and CSCL13 (at a suggested threshold of 10 pg/mL or more) and anti-treponemal IgA assays.[162][177][184][162][186][187]
All patients with syphilis should be tested for other STDs, particularly HIV.
Conversely, all HIV-positive patients should be serologically tested for syphilis.
Benzathine penicillin G should be administered if the serology tests are positive, and follow-up testing should be scheduled.
